subject: Coordinating exec demo across US / EU / APAC — proposed windows
messages:
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@brightpay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightpay.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Exec demo request — cross-region scheduling

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. The execs at BrightPay are keen to see Redwood in a short, focused demo we can run for stakeholders in Dublin (procurement/legal), New York (CFO + product lead) and Singapore (ops lead).

High-level asks: 30–45 minute run, one or two execs from our side (CFO + IT lead), and an ops deep-dive for the APAC team. Their windows are tight: Dublin team prefers after 09:30 BST, New York needs before 11:00 EDT, and Singapore prefers after 16:00 SGT.

We also have a procurement call lined up the week after demo — if we can get mutual action items (MAP) attached, that would help speed things up.

Can you share a couple of concrete time options (UTC times are fine) and who from Redwood will present? Note: the Singapore team will be out for a public holiday on 2027-09-25, so anything near that date is tricky. Also flagged that DST changes in late October could affect later follow-ups.

Thanks,
Anna

--
Anna Schmidt
Head of Partnerships, BrightPay
anna.schmidt@brightpay.com
+44 7700 900111

Attachments: BrightPay-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@brightpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightpay.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — cross-region scheduling

Hi Anna — great to hear.

We can absolutely run a tight 40-minute exec + ops demo. Proposed slots (UTC shown) that try to respect each region's constraints:

Option A (preferred):
- 09:30 UTC / 10:30 BST (Dublin) / 05:30 EDT (New York) / 17:30 SGT (Singapore) — 40 mins
Option B:
- 12:00 UTC / 13:00 BST / 08:00 EDT / 20:00 SGT — 40 mins (later for APAC)
Option C (backup, earlier APAC):
- 07:00 UTC / 08:00 BST / 03:00 EDT / 15:00 SGT — 40 mins (not ideal for NY)

Notes:
- Option A keeps Dublin post-9:30 BST and hits early NY (we recommend the CFO join the recording for a short Q&A rather than live if 05:30 EDT is too early).
- I'll lead the platform walkthrough + cost/perf Q&A; Karthik will handle dedicated/private deployment and SLAs in the last 10 minutes. Evelyn will join for SRE/observability questions.

I'll attach a short demo brief and a one-page MAP we can pre-fill with next steps. If one of these works, I'll send a calendar invite with an ICS and a run-of-show.

If you prefer, we can run the demo slightly outside these slots and offer a recorded deep-dive for the region that misses live attendance.

Cheers,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@brightpay.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightpay.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 04:15:00 +05:30
Subject: RE: Exec demo request — cross-region scheduling

Quick follow-up from my side with a couple of operational constraints to keep in mind:

- Execs + CFO: plan for 30 minutes of live demo + 10 minutes of prioritized Q&A. If NY execs prefer not to wake for 05:30 EDT, propose they watch first 30 minutes live and join for the last 10 via the recording marker.
- SRE/ops (APAC): we should allocate 10 minutes for KV cache/latency tradeoffs and routing policies; I'll prepare two one-slide comparisons (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- On DST: US daylight saving ends 2027-11-07 and EU ends 2027-10-31. If we plan follow-up sessions in Oct/Nov, call out timezone conversions explicitly in calendar invites (avoid ambiguous labels).

Also throwing a third slot that sometimes works for execs who are fine with early NY:
Option D:
- 13:00 UTC / 14:00 BST / 09:00 EDT / 21:00 SGT — 40 mins

If Vanessa wants, I can draft a single-line scheduling grid with local times per stakeholder to paste into the invite.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@brightpay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightpay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 08:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — cross-region scheduling

Thanks Vanessa & Karthik — taking these to the group. Quick notes from procurement: we absolutely need Dublin attendees after 09:30 BST and prefer the first 30 minutes to include a short slide on data residency and SOC 2 evidence.

Tom (cc'd) — what's the latest you can do? The NY execs said 08:30–10:30 EDT is optimal. If we can do Option D at 09:00 EDT, that slots nicely for NY and is barely after 09:30 BST.

If BrightPay confirms Option D, we'll have CFO + IT lead live in NY, procurement + legal in Dublin (after 09:30 BST), and ops lead in Singapore (will join live at 21:00 SGT).

Anna

--
Anna Schmidt
Head of Partnerships, BrightPay

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@brightpay.com>, Tom O'Neil <tom.oneil@brightpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Exec demo — 2027-09-14 13:00 UTC (Option D)

All — thanks for aligning. We will lock Option D and I have created a calendar invite (ICS attached) for: 2027-09-14 13:00 UTC / 14:00 BST / 09:00 EDT / 21:00 SGT — 40 minutes.

Run-of-show (high level):
- 0:00–5:00 — quick intros and objectives (Vanessa + Anna)
- 5:00–30:00 — platform demo (Vanessa)
- 30:00–35:00 — SLAs, dedicated/private options (Karthik)
- 35:00–40:00 — Ops/observability Q&A (Evelyn)

Prep items for BrightPay:
- Please share any must-cover procurement questions (data residency, retention, audit logs) by EOD 2027-09-09 so we can include short slides.
- Tom, confirm CFO will attend live; if not, we'll mark the recording at minute 30 for them to watch and spot-join for Q&A.

Notes about timezones/DST: calendar invite explicitly lists all local times and includes UTC. We will NOT rely on timezone labels alone (e.g., "BST") for follow-ups in Oct/Nov. For internal SRE/ops sessions post-demo, we'll append the UTC offset date (e.g., "2027-11-08 13:00 UTC (US DST ended)") to avoid confusion.

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (ics, 2KB) and updated MAP pre-fill (BrightPay-MAP-v1.xlsx) included.

See you all on the 14th — I'll ping again with dial-in details and a Zoom link + recording permissions.

Best,
Vanessa
